> Please note: Abysner has a specific scope and direction, and not all requests fit it. Starting a
> discussion before a large request is often the better first step. See
> [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

**What problem would this solve?**
Describe the need or the gap you are running into.

**What would you like to see?**
A clear description of the feature or change.

**Alternatives you have considered**
Other ways to solve the same problem, if any.

**Anything else?**
Context, examples, or references.
